ANWArgentines.doctrine_prose: Pushes barracks, stables, and outposts up toward the map's contested edge, leaving the home base lightly fortified. Sustained pressure is the doctrine: shipments rally to the forward base, and lost ground is re-walled rather than abandoned.

blurb.civ_bonus: Home City Shipments arrive slightly faster; elite infantry never rout.
blurb.playstyle: Rush forward base, mass Granaderos and Lancers with Musketeer screen; push and re-wall rather than defend home base.

ANWAztecs.doctrine_prose: Hugs natural chokes — cliffs, jungle, river bends — and substitutes War Huts and causeways for walls. Stages quick, repeated infantry strikes from forward warbands and refuses to fight in the open.

blurb.civ_bonus: Builds Warchief units and earns XP through Tribute; no Colonial age-up cost.
blurb.playstyle: Tribute boom to 18+ villagers, harass with Macehualtin + Coyote Runners in Colonial, FF to Jaguar/Eagle Knight mass; hug chokes, avoid open fights.

ANWBarbary.doctrine_prose: Builds the docks first. Two or three Docks plus a full fishing fleet come before the second barracks, then a wall ring locks down the harbor. Land army arrives via naval shipments and mercenary contracts — the home city pays for the war.

blurb.civ_bonus: Can train Privateers with increased build limit, which can train additional units.
blurb.playstyle: Dock-first naval economy; Corsair raids deny enemy trade; Barbary Warriors and mercs close land fights; Xebecs dominate water maps.

ANWBrazil.doctrine_prose: Scatters Mills, Plantations, and Markets across multiple resource patches so production never bottlenecks on one site. Light walling, heavy investment in Market upgrades, and a constant villager trickle to the most under-worked node.

blurb.civ_bonus: Receives a free Covered Wagon with every Age; starts with 7 Citizens.
blurb.playstyle: Spread Mills and Plantations across multiple resource patches for a bottleneck-free economy; Covered Wagon trickle expands the economic footprint; Voluntarios from Town Centers back up a Market-heavy late game.

ANWBritish.doctrine_prose: Builds the docks first. Two or three Docks plus a full fishing fleet come before the second barracks, then a wall ring locks down the harbor. Land army arrives via naval shipments and mercenary contracts — the home city pays for the war.

blurb.civ_bonus: Manors automatically spawn a Settler when built.
blurb.playstyle: Boom via Manor-spawned Settlers; wall harbor early; Musketeer + Longbow lines; strong navy; land army funded by naval shipments and mercenary contracts.

ANWCanadians.doctrine_prose: Clusters every production building tight around the Town Center, walls early with stone, and only walks out for nearby resources. Expects to be sieged, not skirmished — the AI hunkers in and counter-attacks from a hardened core.

blurb.civ_bonus: Manor spawns a Metis Pathfinder when built; Villagers gain ranged attack each Age; starts with a Native Scout and trains Metis Voyageurs alongside Settlers.
blurb.playstyle: Boom Manors for Metis Pathfinders; turtle home base with stone walls and Outpost militia; counter-attack from a hardened core with Ranger skirmish line and Cuirassier shock at Fortress.
blurb.age_up: Wagon politicians with Blockhouse (Brock) or tight-core civic politicians (Papineau / Lower Canada)

Home-city shipments and mercenary contracts keep the cavalry stream fed.
